title: Movie Gift Card
description: This full-color, glossy 2" x 3.5" card serves to advertise all six of Living Waters' free YouTube movies by directing the reader to http://www.FullyFreeFilms.com.     - The Atheist Delusion   - "180"   - Evolution vs God   - Genius   - Noah & The Last Days   - Audacity   You just say, "Here are six free movies--seen by millions--five are award-winning. I hope you enjoy them."   Cards available at: http://store.livingwaters.com/fullyfreefilms-promo-card.html  Watch more free videos and get other resources by Ray Comfort and Living Waters at http://www.LivingWaters.com

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it promotes a physical “Movie Gift Card” that directs people to six free religious-themed films. The speaker describes the card and website and encourages ordinary distribution, such as leaving cards on a desk or inviting people to take one, without presenting an investment, prize, paid financial opportunity, deceptive conditions, or private-data collection.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content concerns an ordinary physical promotional product: a movie gift card used to advertise films and distribute information about them. The supplied evidence does not show a gift-card claim, reward-verification flow, investment opportunity, credential request or paid earning guidance.
